title: Maintenance reminders: after a print, extra screen windows (and phone messages) for the X/Y rails every 100 print hours and the Z screws and fans every 300
note: Counts print hours (saved in saved_variables.cfg) and after a print that crosses a multiple of 100 h (X/Y rails) or 300 h (Z lead screws, fans) shows an extra window on the printer screen, one window per interval, and sends a phone message without buttons when phone-notifications is installed. Only a notice, once per interval: nothing to confirm. QIDI manual: rails every 2-4 weeks, Z screws every 1-3 months. TWEAKED_MAINT_STATUS in Fluidd shows the hours. Counting starts at installation. A tick every 5 s only reads the print state.
